St eiip2930 is not refilled I should add sanity check for london rules What about gasLimit errors? c34cab0b8279671a337c9cd2938f41269b1adc89 let me double check the gasLimit errors Geth seems to be having some issues still: ``` --- FAIL: TestBlockchain (1.07s) --- FAIL: TestBlockchain/InvalidBlocks/bcUncleHeaderValidity/gasLimitTooLowExactBound.json (0.05s) --- FAIL: TestBlockchain/InvalidBlocks/bcUncleHeaderValidity/gasLimitTooLowExactBound.json/gasLimitTooLowExactBound_London (0.01s) block_test.go:51: test without snapshotter failed: block #3 insertion into chain failed: invalid gas limit: have 3141588, want 3144658 +-= 3069 block_test.go:54: test with snapshotter failed: block #3 insertion into chain failed: invalid gas limit: have 3141588, want 3144658 +-= 3069 --- FAIL: TestBlockchain/InvalidBlocks/bcEIP1559/gasLimit20m.json (0.01s) block_test.go:51: test without snapshotter failed: block #2 insertion into chain failed: invalid gas limit: have 19980469, want 20000000 +-= 19530 block_test.go:54: test with snapshotter failed: block #2 insertion into chain failed: invalid gas limit: have 19980469, want 20000000 +-= 19530 --- FAIL: TestBlockchain/InvalidBlocks/bcEIP1559/badBlocks.json (0.01s) block_test.go:51: test without snapshotter failed: block #2 insertion into chain failed: invalid gas limit: have 1072693248, want 1073741824 +-= 1048575 block_test.go:54: test with snapshotter failed: block #2 insertion into chain failed: invalid gas limit: have 1072693248, want 1073741824 +-= 1048575 --- FAIL: TestBlockchain/InvalidBlocks/bcEIP1559/gasLimit40m.json (0.01s) block_test.go:51: test without snapshotter failed: block #2 insertion into chain failed: invalid gas limit: have 39960938, want 40000000 +-= 39061 block_test.go:54: test with snapshotter failed: block #2 insertion into chain failed: invalid gas limit: have 39960938, want 40000000 +-= 39061 ``` The `BerlinToLondonTransition` seems fixed though Investigating... Github seems partially down, hence why I posted here instead of on the ticket I think the lower bound is miscalculated by retesteth, it has an off-by-one The `block #2 insertion into chain failed: invalid gas limit: have 19980469, want 20000000 +-= 19530` -- so retesteth thinks `19980469` is ok, geth thinks `19980470` is the lowest allowed ``` >>> 20000000-20000000//1024 19980469 ``` From EIP ``` assert block.gas_limit > parent_gas_limit - parent_gas_limit // 1024, 'invalid block: gas limit decreased too much' ``` So `block.gas_limit` must be greater than `19980469` This logic was changed, as part of https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/3566 These tests fail on OpenEthereum also. Ideally retesteth should not think. The chain logic must be provided by a generating client. We have besu but it is slow on support ( I'm happy to write a block sealer utility program. Need to know the requirements that still wont be the actual client implementation so basically the gasLimit delta formula check is the same as it was before ? ---? <@!211091239112671234> this tests are supposed to fail so far: (in BlockchainTests) ``` info: (bcBerlinToLondon/BerlinToLondonTransition_BerlinToLondonAt5, fork: BerlinToLondonAt5, block: 9) info: (bcEIP1559/badBlocks_London, fork: London, block: 5) info: (bcEIP1559/gasLimit20m_London, fork: London, block: 2) info: (bcEIP1559/gasLimit40m_London, fork: London, block: 2) info: (bcUncleHeaderValidity/gasLimitTooLowExactBound_London, fork: London, block: 2) ``` now I have expect exception for failing transactions.
